stated: Reform UK will recruit 30,000 full-time personnel for the army, stating that military national service for young people is not the answer.

source.quote: Recruit 30,000 for the army Military national service for 30,000 young people for one year is not the answer. We need to recruit 30,000 to join the army full time

bearing_set.reason: Expanding army personnel by 30,000 directly increases defence capacity and national security posture, earning a real verdict on the safety & security fundamental.

30,000 full-time military recruits represent a substantial ongoing cost (salaries, training, equipment) running to well over £1 billion annually; unless explicitly funded, this materially affects the debt-path sustainability indicator.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: O5 (the policy's direct purpose — defence capacity) and O12 (the unavoidable fiscal commitment of a large permanent headcount expansion). Effects on O4 (labour market) are too small relative to overall employment to clear the non-negligible bar. O13 second-order multiplier effects are speculative and insufficient to warrant inclusion.
